release_notes: Browser 0.30.0: resilient verified Windows FFmpeg provisioning with local/PATH reuse, API-independent checksum fallback, bounded retries, progress and retry controls on both platforms. Successfully assigned downloads remain highlighted yellow across panel/browser restarts. Includes 0.28 shot/folder creation and 0.29 panel retention, Recent shots, clicked thumbnails, copy-path controls, move focus and bounded pane resizing. Browser settings remain independent; FFmpeg is not bundled. Windows release; macOS source handoff requires Mac build and acceptance.
